newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss July trade surplus falls to 24.8 mln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss July trade surplus falls to 24.8 mln Sfr.

text.p: Switzerland's provisional trade surplus fell to 24.8 million Swiss francs in July from a revised 329.7 million surplus in June, the Federal Customs Office said.
Note - Comparative data are revised. The provisional June surplus was reported as 334.3 million francs on imports of 8,614.0 million and exports of 8,948.4 million.
These figures exclude precious metals and stones, works of art and antiques, called Total One.
